name: Ember toad
description: a fat warty toad of the Ember Wastes, red-black skin with glowing orange pustules, a wide mouth full of embers, stubby legs

poses.stand: squatting on its stubby legs, mouth closed, pustules glowing
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: squats, its throat pulsing in and out, pustules glowing

attack.action: puffs up and sprays a fan of embers forward to the right from its wide mouth

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
